description.zh: 按 task.md 一轮一轮地做：先读任务和项目记忆做计划，再实现、检查，把做成和没做成的都记进项目记忆；检查通过或轮数用完时停下请你审核。适合从零开始的大多数项目，在 Studio 里改成你要的样子。
description.en: Work on task.md in rounds: plan from the task and the project's memory, build, check, and record what worked and what did not; stop for your review when the check passes or the rounds run out. A starting point for most projects; change it in the Studio to fit the work.
